title: asset.expired payload
description: Emitted by MAM when a previously-approved asset reaches its expiry (expiresAt) and becomes unusable, requiring manual re-review (FR-APP-7). Fired by MAM's internal scheduler, not a user action. Consumed by Scheduling (drop from schedulable set), Notifications, Logging.

expiredAt.description: The expiresAt that has now been reached.

priorApprover.description: User id whose approval just lapsed.

expirySource.description: Whether expiresAt came from a per-asset override or the inherited category default (FR-TAX-7).
